text: While the local wildlife—including the persistent grizzly bear and grazing gazelles—remained a familiar backdrop to the frontier, tension gripped the colony. Burdened by the wretched conditions of the awful barracks, Dillon Boyd succumbed to his nerves and began wandering in a psychotic state. Amidst the psychological strain, routine survival continued: Lidia 'Stench' Schmitt successfully recovered from her injuries, secured a pack animal in the wooden pen, hauled salvaged steel and silver to the stockpile, and even missed a passing tortoise during a hunt.
